uses.text: Sodium bromide is used to control algae, bacteria, and fungi in water, such as in ornamental ponds.
uses.excerpt: Used to control algae, bacteria, and fungi in water systems (pasteurizing, canning, pulp & paper manufacturing, and ornamental ponds)

uses.text: Sodium bromide is also used to keep moths away from clothing and fleas away from pets.
uses.excerpt: Also used to repel moths from clothing and fleas from pets

appearance.text: Sodium chloride looks like clear, colorless crystals or a white powder made of crystals.
appearance.excerpt: Colorless, transparent crystals or white, crystalline powder

uses.text: Salt is one of the oldest food seasonings, and salting is an important way to preserve food.
uses.excerpt: Salt is one of the oldest and most ubiquitous of food seasonings, and salting is an important method of food preservation.

uses.text: Sodium chloride is used in home water softeners and for highway deicing.
uses.excerpt: home water softeners, highway deicing

uses.text: Salt is used in making plastic and paper.
uses.excerpt: plastic production, paper production

standardState.text: At room temperature, sodium hydroxide is a solid.
standardState.excerpt: At room temperature, sodium hydroxide is a white crystalline odorless solid

appearance.text: Sodium hydroxide is a colorless to white solid with no smell that comes as flakes, beads or grains.
appearance.excerpt: Colorless to white, odorless solid (flakes, beads, granular form).

uses.text: Sodium hydroxide is used to make soaps, paper and rayon.
uses.excerpt: Sodium hydroxide is used to manufacture soaps, rayon, paper

uses.text: It is found in cleaners for drains and ovens.
uses.excerpt: It is commonly present in commercial drain and oven cleaners.

uses.text: It is also used for laundering, bleaching and cleaning metal.
uses.excerpt: It is also used in processing cotton fabric, laundering and bleaching, metal cleaning and processing

appearance.text: Neon is a gas with no color and no smell.
appearance.excerpt: Neon appears as a colorless odorless noncombustible gas.

appearance.text: Oxygen is a gas with no color, no smell and no taste.
appearance.excerpt: Oxygen is a colorless, odorless and tasteless gas.

appearance.text: Platinum is a shiny, silver-gray metal.
appearance.excerpt: Silver-gray, lustrous, malleable and ductile metal

appearance.text: Sulfur looks like pale yellow crystals or powder, with a faint smell of rotten eggs.
appearance.excerpt: Pale yellow crystals or powder with faint odor of rotten eggs

standardState.excerpt: Sulfur dioxide is a colorless gas with a pungent odor.

appearance.text: Sulfur dioxide has no color and has a choking smell.
appearance.excerpt: Sulfur dioxide appears as a colorless gas with a choking or suffocating odor.

uses.text: Sulfur dioxide is used to preserve fruits and other foods.
uses.excerpt: Used to preserve fruits and other foods

uses.text: It is used to bleach wood pulp and paper.
uses.excerpt: to bleach wood pulp and paper

uses.text: It is used to make batteries and glass, and to treat water.
uses.excerpt: manufacture lithium batteries and glass; treat water

appearance.text: Pure zinc is a bluish-white, shiny metal.
appearance.excerpt: Pure zinc is a bluish-white shiny metal.

standardState.text: Crude zinc oxide is a solid.
standardState.excerpt: Crude zinc oxide is a yellow-gray granular solid with no odor.

appearance.text: Zinc oxide is a white or yellowish-white powder.
appearance.excerpt: White or yellowish-white powder

uses.text: Zinc oxide is used in bandages, ointments and sunblock.
uses.excerpt: It is also used in bandages, pastes, ointments, dental cements, and as a sunblock.

uses.text: It is found in baby powder and in creams for diaper rash.
uses.excerpt: in products such as baby powder and barrier creams to treat diaper rashes

uses.text: It is used as a pigment in white paints.
uses.excerpt: As pigment in white paints instead of lead carbonate

standardState.excerpt: White to greyish-white or yellowish solid

appearance.text: Zinc sulfide is a white to grayish-white or yellowish powder.
appearance.excerpt: White to grayish-white or yellowish powder

uses.text: Zinc sulfide is used as a phosphor in glow-in-the-dark products.
uses.excerpt: used as an infrared optical material and as phosphor in applications such as cathode ray tubes and glow in the dark products

uses.text: Zinc sulfide is used as a pigment in paints, inks and cosmetics.
uses.excerpt: Pigment, e.g., for paints, inks, lacquers, & cosmetics

uses.text: Zinc sulfide is used in x-ray screens, television screens and glowing watch faces.
uses.excerpt: Phosphor in x-ray and television screens, and in luminous watch faces.
